h: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ אִיָּר, ו׳ Rosh Chodesh Iyar, 6

p: The twelve permutations of the Name Havayah
correspond to the twelve months of the year.
The first permutation is the Name in its order,
which emerges from the initial letters of
יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ [תְּהִלִּים צו, יא],
and this permutation is for the month of Nissan
וּמִשְׁנַת חֲסִידִים [מַסֶּכֶת חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן פֶּרֶק א]).
and Mishnas Chassidim, Maseches Chodesh Nissan ch. 1).
וְאַחַר כָּךְ צֵירוּף הַשַּׁיָּיךְ לְחֹדֶשׁ זֶה
And next, the permutation belonging to this month
emerges from the initial letters of
יִתְהַלֵּל הַמִּתְהַלֵּל הַשְׂכֵּל וְיָדוֹעַ [יִרְמְיָה ט, כג].
Certainly they did not take up these pesukim
(see Mishnas Chassidim, in the tractates of the months)
that on every Rosh Chodesh one must have in mind
in the permutation belonging to that month,
and with the vowels of the letters
as initial letters or as final letters.
pertains to the holiness of the month.
Now, the permutation of this month
is Yud-Vav with the two Heis in the middle.
It seems that the first Hei is the lower Hei:
and after it the lower Hei,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר [מִשְׁלֵי ג, יט]
along the lines of what it says (Mishlei 3:19):
זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רמח, א; רנח, א),
is called the 'earth' of Kudsha Brich Hu"
and with understanding it is established" —
זוֹ מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
"This is the attribute of HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
Who created the whole world entirely with wisdom."
that runs from end to end, etc."
The beginning of the pasuk is:
"Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, etc.,
that one points to with his finger,
when each one will point with his finger:
and at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
when each one said, "This is my G-d";
and this is the meaning of their saying
וְזֹאת הִיא גַּם כֵּן מְפוֹרָשׁ לָעַיִן
only it is a feminine form,
in which one stands before the King.
This is the meaning of what is said
she is fear, and fear dwells in her";
that is, when one takes to heart
כְּעִנְיַן מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
as in what is said (Zohar III 230a):
"He is truth and she is faith."
and it also cites the pasuk
And then it is written "Yis'halel ha'mis'halel" —
the upper Hei, from Hashem Yisbarach's side:
for through the joining of mind and heart
and knowledge is pleasant to your soul"
the six months of the summer season
and the six months of winter to the King:
Tishrei is the skull of Zeir Anpin,
and Nissan the skull of Rachel
(and in another version, of the Matronisa).
This accords with what is said
follows the order of the letters, Aviv, etc.;
is from the end of the letters.
You are from below to above,
and I am from above to below, etc."
That is, Nissan is from below to above,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (סוֹטָה ה, א)
along the lines of what they said (Sotah 5a):
and everything was from Hashem Yisbarach's side
like the plague of the firstborn,
and likewise the splitting of the Yam Suf,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב נד, א)
and this is the skull of the Matronisa.
And Tishrei is the head of the King,
וְזֶה בָּא עַל יְדֵי הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּת הָאָדָם
and this comes through man's effort,
in "the month of the mighty ones,"
who are mighty in mitzvos (Rosh Hashanah 11a).
And then Iyar is the right ear
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ
This is according to what is said in the Midrash
as the incense-brazier is to garments, etc.;
the two hundred forty-eight limbs of a person
"The heart of the wise man is at his right
and the heart of the fool at his left";
"it stands to reason that the good one is at his right
and the evil one at his left" (Berachos 61a);
and likewise, "for those who go to its right, it is an elixir of life;
for those who go to its left, an elixir of death"
And this is Iyar, the right ear:
And the version of the Geonim in Sefer Yetzirah is
"over hearing, and Iyar in the year"
And Sivan is the left ear,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר [יְשַׁעְיָה ל, כא]
along the lines of what it says (Yeshayah 30:21):
"And your ears shall hear a word
'This is the way, walk in it,'
when you turn right and when you turn left."
that one may make use of a bas kol,
any voice that is not usual —
and a woman's voice in the field";
and even though he knows it is a human voice,
only that it is not a usual voice,
since Hashem Yisbarach caused him to hear it,
"This is the way, walk in it."
And this is what we find:
and say to him, 'Recite your verse for me'";
and even from the nations of the world,
And this is why it says
"when you turn right and when you turn left":
from one who is of the left side,
he will learn from it only the word of Hashem:
"This is the way, walk in it" —
to hear only the word of Hashem.
And this is the holiness of the month of Sivan,
for it is stated in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 27:9):
that is, to empty out the evil
from the heart of the fool completely,
וְאָז לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ רַק דְּבַר ה׳.
and then they will hear nothing but the word of Hashem.
the permutation of the Name for this month
"Malchus that was clothed with ruach hakodesh";
that is, a spirit from that Kodesh
And this is why it says "With wisdom He founded the earth":
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב רַמְבַּ״ן בָּבָא בַתְרָא יב, א).
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר [תְּהִלִּים קט, ד] וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּה,
as it says (Tehillim 109:4), "And I am prayer";
וְשַׁרְיָא בָהּ יִרְאָה (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א ה, ב),
and fear dwells in her" (Zohar I 5b);
(בְּרָכוֹת ו, ב; ט, ב; יא, ב)
the term "fear" is expounded as referring to prayer.
This is why we say before prayer
And this is why it says "Let not ... glory, etc.,
and then "let him who glories, glory"
in all three things it lists.
אֶלָּא אוֹרַיְיתָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רב, א),
and were it not that HaKadosh Baruch Hu
helps him, he could not overcome it"
to pray to Hashem that He help him
to be a mighty one who conquers his yetzer.
וְעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר כִּי אִם בְּזֹאת —
About this it says "but in this":
וְאֵין דְּבָרִים אֶלָּא דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה וְכוּ׳,
'words' means nothing but words of Torah, etc.
They said to Him: We do not know how.
אָמַר לָהֶם בְּכוּ וְהִתְפַּלְּלוּ לְפָנַי וְכוּ׳,
He said to them: Weep and pray before Me, etc."
and likewise, to conquer one's yetzer in the future,
Torah and prayer are also needed.
And this is why it says "but in this":
Yud is Chochmah, Hei is Malchus:
And from the Yud light shines
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ [חֵלֶק ג רנח, א],
as stated in the holy Zohar (III 258a);
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר [תְּהִלִּים קיא, י]
"Good understanding to all who practice them" —
"to those who practice them for their own sake, etc."
and this is the upper Hei:
"and his heart will understand, and he will repent" —
"Then you will understand the fear of Hashem
and knowledge is pleasant to your soul."
together with the crownlet of the Yud,
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג י, ב; סה, ב),
and this is why it says "v'yado'a osi" (and knows Me):
for the Yud draws down from Kesser Elyon.
This is effort from man's side,
and this is only the right ear.
And then Sivan is the left ear,
when the yetzer hara will be cleared out
And the permutation of the Name
that belongs to the month of Sivan
emerges from the initial letters of
supernal Gevurah, which issues from Binah
גַּם כֵּן ה׳ דְּהַשֵּׁנִית ה׳ עִלָּאָה.
so the Hei of "hasheinis" too is the upper Hei.
when one merits the upper Shabbos:
"Fortunate is he who makes them a dwelling
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there."
And this is the left ear:
that even the left side too —
when you turn right and when you turn left."
